'''Conner Bragge''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[June 2001 Austin tournament (9 June)]] on 9 June 2001 with [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|ROPS (Mob Points, IAO, First Strike)]], according to Jeremy Losee's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2432">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-10-no-tag-austin-11-june-01d2432/ no-tag-austin-11-june-01], DeckTech (Jeremy "Degenx" Losee, 10 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-10-no-tag-austin-11-june-01d2432/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
